blocks.text: Buying a Mobile or Manufactured Home in Maple Ridge, BC

parts.t: Manufactured and mobile homes provide some of the most accessible single-level living in Maple Ridge, particularly for 55+ downsizers who want a detached footprint, private yard space, and driveway parking without stairs or high price tags. Most manufactured home communities in Maple Ridge are clustered along the Lougheed Highway (Hwy 7) and Hammond Road corridors in Southwest Maple Ridge and West Central.

When comparing Maple Ridge manufactured home listings, the first check is land tenure: most units sit on leased pads governed by the BC Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act (where you purchase the home and pay a monthly pad rent covering water, sewer, garbage, and park maintenance), while select communities operate as bare-land stratas where you own a titled lot.

blocks.text: CSA Z240 / A277 Labels, BC Safety Authority Silver Labels & Park Approval

parts.t: Before removing conditions on any manufactured home in Maple Ridge, buyers and lenders verify three technical items: (1) a valid CSA Z240 MH or CSA A277 certification label (or a Technical Safety BC Electrical Silver Label on older homes), (2) formal park management approval and assignment of the pad tenancy agreement, and (3) electrical panel type (checking for 100-amp service vs. older 60-amp panels or aluminum branch wiring), plumbing piping (checking for Poly-B), roof membrane age, and under-home skirting and blocking.

What is the difference between a pad-rent park and a bare-land strata?

In a leasehold pad-rent park, you own the manufactured home (registered in the BC Manufactured Home Registry) and pay monthly pad rent under the BC Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act. In a bare-land strata, you own the land parcel in the BC Land Title Office and pay a lower monthly strata fee.
How is a pad-rent manufactured home financed in British Columbia?

Because a manufactured home on a leased pad is chattel rather than fee-simple land, standard mortgages require CMHC chattel loan insurance or a specialized credit union chattel mortgage, and lenders strictly require a visible CSA Z240/A277 label or Technical Safety BC Silver Label.
What does monthly pad rent typically cost in Maple Ridge parks?

Monthly pad rent in Maple Ridge manufactured home parks generally ranges from $600 to $1,050 per month depending on the park and whether a new tenancy triggers a market-rate pad rent adjustment upon transfer.
Are Maple Ridge mobile home parks 55+ age-restricted?

Many Maple Ridge manufactured home parks enforce a 55+ age restriction under park rules, while a smaller number of parks welcome all-ages families; always check the park rules and pet restrictions for each specific complex.
Why is the Technical Safety BC Silver Label important on older mobile homes?

If a pre-1970s manufactured home lacks its original factory CSA plate or has had electrical alterations, lenders and insurance companies require a Technical Safety BC Silver Label confirming the electrical system passed safety inspection.
